densePipeline.protocol: Complete five-view synthetic Dense pipeline, explicit equal 8/2 iteration defaults unless CLI-overridden, including view planning, uploads, photometric/geometric/filter/fusion and terminal readbacks. One complete cold/warm-up per variant is separate; measured pairs alternate order. Fresh ShadeDevice/pool=0 each run, one externally owned native GPUDevice shared for driver/pipeline warm-up.
densePipeline.timingMeaning: wallMs ends when the complete Dense result returns; hash/surface comparison and device disposal are excluded. Phase boundaries use completed-reference progress; fusionAndFinalize also includes geometric-stage cleanup, map snapshot callback and final result assembly. onDepthMaps clones existing host maps equally and causes no extra GPU readbacks.
densePipeline.transferMeaning: Runtime upload/read bytes include Resident.write/read for managed arrays. Application-tracked uploads alone omit direct Resident.write. Resident snapshot bytes may exceed requested prefixes. These counters exclude driver staging, textures and physical VRAM.
densePipeline.scope: Synthetic supplied geometry/RGB, not a source-video SfM/Dense reconstruction or native-hardware performance claim. Software adapter identity is reported and --hardware rejects software/fallback.
